description: The file defines a TransactionProvider class that manages a list of transactions for a specific month in a Flutter application. It handles loading, adding, updating, and removing transactions via a TransactionService, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: TransactionProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider class managing a list of transactions for a specific month, supporting CRUD operations.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of transactions for the selected month from the service.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the current month and triggers loading the transactions for that month.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new transaction via the service and updates the local list.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction by ID via the service and updates the local list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a transaction by ID via the service and updates the local list.
